promise: One crore youth will receive AI skill training in the coming year
description: On August 15, 2026, Modi announced a plan to provide AI skills training to ten million young people over the next year.
evidence: Official announcement supports the scale and one-year target; completed training totals were not established.

promise: Provide free online coaching for various competitive examinations for the youth
description: Modi announced free online coaching for competitive examinations on August 15, 2026, using digital public infrastructure and teachers to build a coaching network.
evidence: The official announcement contains no explicit coaching rollout deadline.

review.note: The free-coaching announcement is supported, but the one-year deadline belongs to AI training, not coaching. An editorial review anniversary must not become a promised delivery date.
